name: 80s Cel Anime
description: An 80s cel-anime opening on videotape: a neon city at night, flat cels with hard shadows and rim light, speed lines and impact frames, an eye close-up with a glint, a chrome title with a katakana line, and a burst of light on the final hit. For deadlines, launches, hype and dramatic countdowns.

inputs.label: Dil
inputs.help: Upper case follows it (Turkish i → İ; English i → I)

inputs.label: Katakana satırı
inputs.help: Over the title; katakana reads as anime, Latin works too

inputs.label: Son saat
inputs.help: HH:MM; the desk clock shows two minutes before, the impact frame one minute before

inputs.label: Tuş
inputs.help: The big key she slams on the final hit

inputs.label: Anlatım
inputs.default: Saat on bir elli sekiz... Proje teslimine iki dakika. Ve o, pes etmeyecek.
inputs.help: Spell the time out for the voice

beats.label: Crane down from the moon over the neon city to her lit window
Narration starts; over-the-monitor shot, the desk clock two minutes before the deadline
Impact frame: the clock hits one minute before, on the word for the minute
Eye strip: her eyes snap open with a glint, push into the highlight
Chrome title with the katakana line and the LED deadline, on the music's big hit
Her finger slams the key on the final hit; a burst of light resolves to the city
beats.sfx: big keyboard key slam, bright energy burst

voice.direction: An intense anime-trailer narrator: low, urgent, with real pauses between phrases. Strip eleven_v3 tags from the word timings and re-time each phrase to its measured pause before captions.

music.prompt: 80s Japanese city pop anime opening, energetic synth brass, slap bass, gated drums, bright synth lead, 129 BPM, big hit at 9.6 seconds and a final hit at 14.8 seconds, instrumental, no vocals

credits.name: Kanit, Dela Gothic One, Barlow Semi Condensed
